title: Hyper-V Provider Config
description: Host-wide settings for the Hyper-V provider. The boxy agent must run on the Hyper-V host as Administrator.

memory_budget_mb.description: Maximum total startup memory, in MB, that Boxy-managed VMs may consume on this Hyper-V host.

host_reserve_mb.description: Memory headroom kept available for the host OS and other processes. Defaults to 512 MB; set to 0 to disable the reserve.

data_dir.description: Directory where this provider's restart-safe state is persisted, currently the per-sandbox network segment ledger (ADR-0021). Relative paths resolve against the boxy config file's own directory when one is known, and against the process's working directory otherwise. Defaults to ".boxy-agent/hyperv".

mesh_endpoint.description: host:port this agent should be dialed at by a peer agent's WireGuard interface for cross-host sandbox traffic. Required only when a sandbox spans this host and another.
